classes.name: Antimuscarinics for overactive bladder
classes.description: Oxybutynin IR/ER/patch/gel, tolterodine IR/ER, solifenacin, darifenacin, trospium IR/ER, fesoterodine (Toviaz).
classes.plainDescription: A daily pill to calm an overactive bladder.

classes.name: Beta-3 agonists for overactive bladder
classes.description: Mirabegron (Myrbetriq, generic mirabegron ER) and vibegron (Gemtesa).
classes.plainDescription: A newer daily bladder pill with fewer dry-mouth and memory side effects.

preferredAgent.sig: 5 mg once daily; may increase to 10 mg (label).

alternatives.note: Preferred (P), QLL, no PA (p76); Toviaz brand not listed

criteria: Age 2 to 4 with neurogenic detrusor overactivity (NDO).
Age 5 to 17 with NDO and inadequate response, allergy, contraindication, drug interaction, or intolerable side effect to oxybutynin.
Ineffectiveness, allergy, contraindication, drug interaction, or intolerable side effects to at least two preferred products.
Only one of the two preferred products may be an oxybutynin product.
